newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle sets $300 mln convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Nestle sets $300 mln convertible bond.

text.p: Swiss food and beverage conglomerate Nestle SA said its unit Nestle Holdings Inc. had launched a five-year $300 million, three percent, convertible bond.
Nestle said in a statement final terms of the offering will be fixed later today by the banking syndicate led by Credit Suisse First Boston.
The bonds will be convertible into existing shares of Nestle so the issue neither presents an increase in equity, nor a dilution in earnings per share.
"The bond issue aims to take advantage of the present favourable interest conditions," Nestle said.
